title: Soothing to the subconscious
content: Mall culture was big when I was a kid. That's where my parents took us most weekends and where I went as a teen with my friends. I view shopping now as a horrible experience and I have social anxiety that makes it difficult. I feel very self conscious in stores and feel strange attention on me. I would rather be anonymous and invisible. But in these mall dreams I enjoy shopping again. I find beautiful clothing, in great colors and beautiful fabrics that make me feel great. And the people who work in these stores and are shopping in these stores are very pleasant. I'm frustrated when I wake up because I have to wonder why shopping doesn't feel like this anymore.
